definitions.gloss: Nagoya Castle, famous for the golden shachihoko on its roof
definitions.explanation: A castle in Nagoya built from 1610 on the orders of Tokugawa Ieyasu for his son's domain of Owari. Its main keep is crowned by a pair of golden shachihoko, mythical fish-tigers that became the symbol of the city. The keep burned in an air raid in 1945 and was rebuilt in concrete in 1959.
